text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
Somewhere, something incredible is waiting to be known.
In the depth of winter, I finally learned that within me there lay an invincible summer.
He who has a why to live for can bear almost any how.
It is only with the heart that one can see rightly. What is essential is invisible to the eye.
Do what you must, and come what may.
You have power over your mind, not over outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
Do less, better.
Live as though you were dying, and as though you had just been born.
What stands in the way becomes the way.
All things belong to others, only time is ours.
While we are postponing life, it passes by.
Nothing is lost while life remains.
We suffer not from what happens to us, but from what we think about it.
Never say of anything that you have lost it. Say that you have given it back.
The people who are crazy enough to think they can change the world are the ones who do.
We are a way for the cosmos to know itself.
Try and leave this world a little better than you found it.
We are just an advanced breed of monkeys on a minor planet. But we can understand the Universe.
If we did all the things we are capable of, we would literally astound ourselves.
